nodes.name: IF Pretreatment
nodes.procedure: IF was cut into a size of 1 cm × 4 cm and washed in concentrated hydrochloric acid for 5 min. The IF was quickly placed in deionized (DI) water for ultrasonic cleaning (2 min), then cleaned 3 times with DI water and anhydrous alcohol. Finally, the IF was vacuum-dried overnight at 60 °C.
nodes.source_text: First of all, IF was cut into a size of 1 cm × 4 cm and washed in concentrated hydrochloric acid for 5 min... Finally, the IF was vacuum-dried overnight at 60 °C.

nodes.name: NiFe/IF Hydrothermal Synthesis
nodes.procedure: Ni(NO3)2·6H2O (0.75 mmol), NH4F (1.5 mmol), and urea (15 mmol) were dissolved in 30 mL DI water and stirred for 20 min. Next, the obtained homogeneous solution was poured into a 50 mL autoclave, and the cleaned IF (1 cm × 4 cm) was inclined and put into the autoclave, and placed in an oven at 90 °C for 3 h. The obtained product was repeatedly washed with DI water and ethanol after cooling down and then dried in a vacuum at 60 °C. The final product is defined as NiFe/IF.

nodes.description: OER stability at multiple current densities in 1 M KOH
nodes.source_text: the NiFe/IF operates stably for 40 h at high current densities of 100 mA cm−2, 500 mA cm−2, and even runs steadily over 7 h at a large current density of 1200 mA cm−2.
